name: WebAsk MCP
description: Create and manage WebAsk surveys, forms and quizzes, read responses, and prepare analytics reports through a hosted MCP server.

inputs.label: WebAsk API key
inputs.description: Your WebAsk API key. Access is limited by the permissions of the WebAsk account that created it.

obtain.instructions:
1. Sign in to your WebAsk account.
2. Open Settings > API / MCP.
3. Click Create API key.
4. Save the key when it is displayed and enter it here.

auth.instructions: Create an API key in your WebAsk account under Settings > API / MCP. The server requires an Authorization: Bearer header; requests without a key return HTTP 401.
